coverage: Read original schematic, PCB and requirements; confirmed their hashes match the packet.
Freshly exported native schematic connectivity using KiCad 10.0.7 and independently traced saved front copper from J1.1 through R1 to J1.2, including the /OUT T junction.
Inspected placement, outline, tracks, via and saved ground zone; reviewed native ERC/DRC reports, ignored checks and geometry records.
Calculated R1 continuous dissipation with the specified external source and clamp. Structural checks contain no stimulus or power assessment for this condition.

findings.condition: /IN held at 48 V DC and /OUT externally clamped to 0 V indefinitely.

evidence.locator: Line 1: external voltage/clamp condition and fitted R1 continuous limit of 0.1 W
R1 instance, UUID c5c38e1a-7593-5c99-b971-2f9d2e7bef78; lines 1261–1285: fitted, value 10k
R1 pads, lines 359–373; J1 pads, lines 587–613; saved /IN and /OUT copper, lines 667–697
nets /IN and /OUT: R1.1 connects to J1.1; R1.2 connects to J1.2
verified_routes and calculation: R1_current_A=0.0048, R1_power_W=0.2304, limit_ratio=2.304

findings.location: R1, saved PCB position (105, 100) mm, between /IN and /OUT
findings.mechanism: The maintained voltage across the nominal 10 kΩ resistor produces continuous dissipation P=(48−0)²/10000=0.2304 W, exceeding its stated 0.1 W continuous limit by 0.1304 W.
findings.reasoning: Saved copper provides the input path to R1.1 and the return from R1.2 through J1.2 to the external clamp. The clamp prevents /OUT from charging toward /IN, so this dissipation persists. R1 operates at 2.304 times the specified continuous limit. The capacitor and ground pour do not remove the maintained resistor voltage. This establishes a power-limit violation without assuming a package rating, operating temperature or failure time.
findings.title: R1 dissipates 0.2304 W against its 0.1 W continuous limit

limitations: No hardware measurements, thermal simulation, temperature or failure-time prediction, or copper ampacity qualification were performed.
Saved zone fill was inspected without refilling. Ignored ERC/DRC categories were not independently rerun; no fabrication capability audit or assembly inspection was performed.
Analysis uses native nominal resistance and the stipulated external holding/clamping condition. Other operating conditions, component ratings, tolerances and ECU qualification were outside scope.
Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/README.md and commands.json.
